entries.93a279683bf8005f: Under the corporate philosophy “The development of the company, the happiness of employees, the satisfaction of shareholders and the abundance of society are one in four-fold unity,” it has set out a medium- to long-term management strategy that concentrates management resources in markets where dramatic growth is expected from technological innovation in generative AI and progress toward a decarbonized society. As priority issues to address, it cites developing differentiated products that leverage ceramic technology; selecting and focusing on markets with expected growth, such as the new energy vehicle market, the optical communications market and semiconductor-related markets; strengthening its global organization; and strengthening its crisis management system. Numerical targets for management indicators are forward-looking matters and are therefore not stated here.
